title: VANTAGE Inter-Agent Handoff Envelope
description: Base envelope schema wrapping all inter-agent handoff artifacts in the VANTAGE framework. Every artifact passed between phases must conform to this structure.

trace_id.description: Unique identifier for tracing this artifact through the pipeline.

source_agent.description: Agent that produced this artifact, e.g. '08-security-architect'.

target_agent.description: Intended recipient agent. Omit for broadcast artifacts consumed by multiple agents.

phase.description: VANTAGE phase that produced this artifact.

artifact_type.description: Type identifier matching a content schema, e.g. 'requirements', 'security-review'.

content.description: The actual payload. Structure depends on artifact_type and is validated by the corresponding content schema.

confidence.description: Agent's confidence in this artifact (0 = no confidence, 1 = fully confident). Useful for downstream agents to weight decisions.

risks.description: Known risks or caveats the producing agent wants to flag for downstream consumers.
